Code and data for more than 50 plots are available in this repository. Run `npm run list` to print an overview or take a look at the tables on this page.

## Individual Plot Metadata

All plots are published on the [Open Research Data Platform](https://forschung.stadtgeschichtebasel.ch) of Stadt.Geschichte.Basel as `pdf` with metadata annotation. The numerical data behind the plots is also available as `csv`. The following section features tables with **selected** metadata on each `csv` file (in German)[^1]. The full `csv` metadata are available in this repository in `json` format.

[^1]: A few duplicated values are to be expected, because in several cases, multiple `csv` files make up one plot and thus share the same metadata for `title` or `description` etc.

```{r, results="asis"}
#| echo: false
#| message: false

library(jsonlite)
library(here)
library(fs)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# find all metadata JSON files recursively
json_files <- dir_ls(here("data", "clean"), 
                     recurse = TRUE, 
                     regexp = "-metadata\\.json$")

# parse all files into a list of field lists
all_fields <- lapply(json_files, function(f) {
  meta <- fromJSON(f)
  schema <- meta$tables$tableSchema
  
  list(
    Figure    = schema$isPartOf$ObjectID[[1]],
    Metadata = f, # store path to JSON
    Title     = schema$title[[1]],
    Description = schema$description[[1]],
    Date      = schema$date[[1]],
    Coverage  = schema$coverage[[1]],
    Volume    = schema$isPartOf$volume[[1]],
    "Source (Data)" = schema$source[[1]],
    "Reference Link (Data)" = schema$bibliographicCitation[[1]]
    
  )
})

# convert to data frame
all_fields_df <- bind_rows(all_fields)

# extract band number and short band title
all_fields_df <- all_fields_df %>%
  mutate(
    BandNum  = sapply(str_extract_all(Volume, "\\d+"), function(x) {
      if (length(x) == 0) NA_integer_ else as.integer(tail(x, 1))
    }),
    BandKurz = ifelse(is.na(BandNum), Volume, paste0("Volume ", BandNum))
  )

# ---- Detailed tables grouped by Band ----
# sort by BandNum and then Figure
all_fields_df <- all_fields_df %>% arrange(BandNum, Figure)

# get unique bands in order
bands <- unique(all_fields_df$BandKurz)

for (band in bands) {
  cat("### ", band, "\n\n")   # level-3 heading for the volume
  
  band_entries <- all_fields_df %>% filter(BandKurz == band)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(band_entries))) {
    fields <- band_entries[i, ]
    
    # level-4 heading for each plot
    cat("#### ", fields$Title, "\n\n")
    
    # convert Figure to a clickable hyperlink
    fields$Figure <- paste0("[", fields$Figure, "](https://forschung.stadtgeschichtebasel.ch/items/", fields$Figure, ".html)")
    
    # relative path from project root to the metadata file
    rel_path <- fs::path_rel(fields$Metadata, start = here())

    # remove "docs/" prefix if it exists
    rel_path <- gsub("^docs/", "", rel_path)

    # use just the filename as label
    filename <- fs::path_file(fields$Metadata)

    # create Markdown link
    fields$Metadata <- paste0("[", filename, "](/", rel_path, ")")
    
    # build table (exclude Title, BandKurz, BandNum)
    df <- data.frame(
      Key = names(fields)[!(names(fields) %in% c("Title", "BandKurz", "BandNum"))],
      Value      = unname(unlist(fields[!(names(fields) %in% c("Title", "BandKurz", "BandNum"))])),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    
    print(knitr::kable(df, format = "markdown"))
  }
}
```
